description: This file defines the 'Symbol' class and associated constants, functions, and methods used for symbol handling within the PyTorch ATen core framework. It provides mechanisms for creating, querying, and managing interned symbols, especially representing operators, attributes, and namespace tags.

classes.name: Symbol
classes.description: Represents an interned symbol string with namespace support, used to identify operators and attributes efficiently within the PyTorch framework

methods.name: Symbol::fromQualString
methods.description: Creates a Symbol object from a qualified string like 'aten::add'
